title: transcribe the voiceover
summary: `vo.mp3` (or `vo.mp4`/`mov`/`mkv`/`m4a`/`wav` — audio auto-extracted to `vo.mp3`) + optional `script.txt` → `transcript.json` (word timestamps, cleaned — never raw ASR punctuation; script-first alignment when `script.txt` exists, else an LLM cleanup pass, both gated by `checkTimingIntegrity()`)
